capabilities: render React components written in Markdown code blocks
persist component state in note frontmatter or localStorage
read vault files from components via a readFile utility
import browser libraries from cdnjs at runtime
draw 2D/3D graphics and charts with canvas, THREE.js, D3, and Lightweight Charts
disambiguation: Not about reactive or backlinked note-taking; the name refers to React, and the plugin runs React components inside Markdown code blocks.
extras: Desktop only; mobile is not yet supported. Security model: CDN imports restricted to cdnjs.cloudflare.com, no external network requests, code runs in a sandbox. Future plans include AI-generated components via MCP integration and preset component templates.
problem: Obsidian notes are static documents, so users who want interactive UIs, live visualizations, or computed content inside their notes have to leave the vault or use separate tools.

relations.evidence: seamlessly integrates React's component ecosystem with Obsidian's powerful note-taking capabilities
D3 force layout integration for network graphs

summary: Code-execution plugin that renders React components written in Markdown code blocks, with persistent state, vault file access, and bundled chart/3D libraries.
